conditions.evidence: nosocomial lower respiratory tract infections in ICU patients
conditions.label: nosocomial lower respiratory tract infections

modalities.evidence: DNA extraction, gene sequencing of the 16S ribosomal unit

output.population: Adult ICU patients requiring mechanical ventilation without initial pneumonia, in an ICU in Chia, Colombia
output.summary: Prospective observational ICU study of the respiratory microbiome in mechanically ventilated adults, with clinical data and bronchoalveolar lavage, orotracheal secretion and blood samples analyzed by 16S ribosomal gene sequencing.
